candidate.raw_translation: Ang bawat manlalaro bids ZXQPH0001QXZ–ZXQPH0002QXZ tricks; isang matagumpay na nil bid scores ZXQPH0003QXZ at isang nabigo nil loses ZXQPH0004QXZ. Team kontrata magdagdag ng kanilang mga non-nil bids: gumawa ng kabuuan para sa ZXQPH0005QXZ puntos bawat bid, plus isang bag para sa bawat karagdagang trick; miss ito at mawalan ng ZXQPH0006QXZ puntos bawat bid. Bawat sampung naipon bag bawasan ZXQPH0007QXZ puntos. Mga manlalaro ay dapat sundin ang suit na humantong kapag posible. Spades ay hindi maaaring humantong hanggang nasira maliban kung ang isang manlalaro ay may lamang spades, at isang spade beats anumang non-spade card.
candidate.source: The standard 52-card deck is dealt evenly. Each player bids 0–13 tricks; a successful nil bid scores 100 and a failed nil loses 100. Team contracts add their non-nil bids: make the total for 10 points per bid, plus one bag for each extra trick; miss it and lose 10 points per bid. Every ten accumulated bags subtract 100 points. Players must follow the suit led when possible. Spades cannot be led until broken unless a player holds only spades, and a spade beats any non-spade card.
